title: Pre-registration: Enforcing Document Permissions in Vector Search, an Experimental Comparison
description: Study plan, hypotheses H1 to H8 with their judging rules, measures and analysis, deposited before any measured run, together with the benchmark harness at the same commit. The pre-registration is prereg/PREREGISTRATION.md; everything seen before deposit (continuous-integration runs on synthetic data and timing-only pilots) is listed in its section 1. Code and history: https://github.com/muzakkirhussain011/rag-permission-bench. The study includes wardowl, the author's own library, as one arm; this is a declared conflict of interest.
